title: GAP Waiver Premier 150 Worksheet: Share of the Loan-to-Value Excess Removed
content:
**GAP Waiver Addenda, GAP Waiver Premier 150 worksheet benefit.** The share of the loan-to-value excess the worksheet benefit removes follows the loan-to-value at signing of the Retail Installment Contracts contract. That loan-to-value is the amount financed divided by the book value at origination, as a percent.

| Loan-to-value at signing | Share of the excess removed |
|---|---|
| above 130 percent | the whole excess |
| above 115 percent and up to 130 percent | the installments still to fall due, divided by the original term |
| 115 percent or less | the starting balance the claim shows, divided by the amount financed |

**Installments still to fall due.** These are the original term less the due dates from the first payment date through the date of loss. Those due dates are the whole months from the first payment date to the date of loss, plus one, and none before the first payment date. The count is never below none.

**Boundaries:**

- 130.5 percent removes the whole excess;
- exactly 130 percent removes the installment share;
- exactly 115 percent removes the balance share.

*Hypothetical case.* A 60-month contract signed at 124 percent has a loss after 18 due dates. The share removed is 42 divided by 60, which is 0.70 of the excess.
